description: A board of a project: a `*.canvas` file in its `boards` folder, in the open JSON Canvas 1.0 format (jsoncanvas.org), so Obsidian opens it too. A test is a `file` node that points at its `*.flow.json`; what only JEVision uses sits under `jevision` keys. Keys JEVision doesn't know are kept as they are.

items.description: An arrow between two nodes. Keys JEVision doesn't know are kept.

color.description: One of the preset colors `1` to `6` (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, purple), or `#rrggbb`; empty or left out for none.

fromEnd.description: `arrow` for an arrowhead at the start; there is none unless the file says so.

fromNode.description: The id of the node the arrow leaves.

fromSide.description: The side of the node the arrow leaves; empty or left out for the side that faces the other node.

id.description: Unique among the nodes and arrows of the board.

toEnd.description: `none` for no arrowhead at the end; there is one unless the file says not.

toNode.description: The id of the node the arrow points at.

toSide.description: The side of the node the arrow arrives at; empty or left out for the side that faces the other node.

allTests.description: Every test of the project is on this board: new tests appear on it by themselves, in the frame of their folder, and deleted ones go away.

nodes.description: In drawing order: later nodes are drawn over earlier ones, so frames come before what they hold.

file.description: A file of the project, relative to the project folder with `/` between folders: a test when it ends in `.flow.json`, another board when it ends in `.canvas`.

open.description: The card shows the blocks of the test inside it.

url.description: The address of the web page.

collapsed.description: Folded to its title bar; what lies inside isn't shown.

folder.description: The test folder it holds on the board of all tests, relative to the project; empty for the project folder.

items.description: A thing on the board. Keys JEVision doesn't know are kept.

color.description: One of the preset colors `1` to `6` (red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, purple), or `#rrggbb`; empty or left out for none.

height.description: Board points; rounded to whole ones.

id.description: Unique among the nodes and arrows of the board.

type.description: `text` for a note in Markdown, `file` for a test, another board or a picture, `link` for a web page and `group` for a frame.

width.description: Board points; rounded to whole ones.

x.description: Board points from the board's origin, to the right.

y.description: Board points from the board's origin, downwards.

title: JEVision board
